# Optional App Store "What's New" override. Keep this file comment-only between
# releases so dist/app-store-release-notes.sh derives notes from commits.
#
# To override one release, add `# Release version: x.y.z` and the user-facing
# text below it. The script rejects missing or stale version markers before any
# store upload.
# Release version: 0.2.22

• Direct messages now reuse the right conversation and keep updating while the
  app is in the background.
• The direct-message list is easier to scan, and message history no longer
  jumps back when older requests finish late.
• Fixed Shift+Enter newlines and Enter-to-send in the desktop composer.
• Empty spaces now show clear join or admin actions instead of a spinner.
• Improved markdown readability and contrast.
